description: This file defines the AdminEvaluationController class, which manages performance review evaluations within the OrangeHRM system's performance module. It extends a base Vue controller and uses traits for services and roles. It handles pre-rendering logic, access control, and sets properties for the review component based on review data.

classes.name: AdminEvaluationController
classes.description: Controller for administering performance reviews, handling rendering and access control based on performance review IDs.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view component for rendering by fetching performance review data by ID, and setting properties for the view.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the user has the capability to access the specified performance review.

methods.name: setReviewProps
methods.description: Sets properties on the view component based on the performance review data.

methods.name: isUserPerformanceReviewEvaluator
methods.description: Determines if the current user is an evaluator for the specified performance review.
